purpose: Define when page264 may safely release exclusive WordPress write scope after the current v006/v007 implementation lane, without treating tool unavailability, screenshot-only evidence or a read-only checkpoint as completion.
scope_authority: STATE.md remains PAGE264 ONLY until these criteria are actually proven and the full state history is safely preserved during a normal handoff.
blocking_write_capable_items: Fresh trustworthy source/target live gate for v006 request-contact foreground.
Fresh trustworthy source/target live gate for v007 desktop comparison equal-column parity.

Apply the visual minimality gate before selecting an artifact: use exact computed-owner evidence if available, but do not invent a narrower alternative from screenshot inference when such tooling is unavailable.
If either/both failures still reproduce, exactly one selected current repository artifact/bundle insertion through oldtrees-next-remote-window-v006 plus mandatory server/browser readback.
If neither fails, explicit fresh evidence that both are source-equivalent and no v006/v007 write is required.
mandatory_release_evidence: Intended +5 WPVibe identity, target site connection and exact quota were verified in the successful live closeout window; >=10 D11 reserve preserved.
Fresh page264 _elementor_data bytes/SHA/JSON reconciled and valid.
Additional CSS has exactly one af-project:end, exactly one accepted v004 and v005 marker, and any selected v006/v007 marker exactly once; no unreconciled duplicate/partial marker.
Changed-section source/target visual check confirms the selected both/one/neither outcome and no regression to accepted v004/v005 surfaces, icons, bullets, form geometry or responsive contracts.
The artifact used for any write is the exact current repository artifact listed by the deploy manifest; no live hand-reconstruction or unregistered narrower variant was used.
No unresolved 429/5xx write outcome remains; every uncertain mutation was converted to exact readback before further action.
No other page264-specific prepared write remains justified by fresh reproduced evidence.

minimality_rule.computed_owner_available: Prefer the smallest separately parser/scope-checked artifact proven by exact winning-rule/computed-style evidence. Any new narrower artifact must be added to the deploy manifest before use.
minimality_rule.computed_owner_unavailable: Do not make screenshot-only ownership claims. If a failure reproduces and the current v006/v007 candidate still passes its normal preflight, the existing parser-checked source-contract artifact remains eligible; do not invent another CSS variant.

items_allowed_to_remain_open_after_relea: Form33 service/topic native-required configuration and safe non-delivery behavior, provided no fallback code has been justified from a reproduced native failure.
Inner MetForm field visual measurements when no synchronized defect has been proven.
Read-only route/href confirmation when no route mismatch is reproduced.
Review/Tiszafa/Nordmann/four-FAQ direct interaction acceptance when action tooling is unavailable and no failure is reproduced.
Hero exact owner/cascade diagnosis when the observed offset has no proven writable owner.
Floating-dock owner discovery when the owner is global/unproven and no strictly page264-scoped correction is justified.
Deterministic six-view pixel/overlay acceptance while the required same-state harness is unavailable.
release_forbidden_if: v006 or v007 is still a reproduced failure without completed write/readback or explicit no-write PASS evidence.
Current page/hash/marker state is unknown or drift is unexplained.
Any page264-specific fix is merely prepared but not reconciled against fresh live truth.
A 429/5xx mutation outcome is still UNKNOWN.
A proposed narrower cascade patch lacks exact owner evidence, parser/scope QA or deploy-manifest registration.
STATE.md cannot be safely updated while preserving complete history.
A parallel page264 QA/write owner is still active.
Release is being inferred only because WPVibe/Opera/public HTTP is unavailable.
handoff_contract_after_release: Re-read fresh STATE.md, current precedence and latest page264 continuation immediately before handoff.
Preserve all existing STATE history; never truncate the file to force a scope switch.
Record page264 closed implementation state and remaining proof-only/formal blockers separately.
Only then allow a later page handoff plan to take write scope.
Shared Opera tabs must be explicitly released; a later page reuses at most those two, with no replacement fan-out.
current_reason_not_released: In the continuation that prepared this gate, WPVibe was unavailable on the first attempt and Opera was disconnected on the single list-tabs attempt. v006/v007 therefore remain conditional implementation candidates requiring fresh live both/one/neither closeout. Static preparation alone is not release evidence.
